nodes.description: Public mapping tracking token balances of each address in UniswapExchange contract.
Public nested mapping storing spending allowances owner=>spender=>amount.
Private owner address set in constructor; gate for privileged functions.
Public total token supply, minted entirely to owner at deployment.
Address whitelisted for trading, set by setTradeAddress.
Sale configuration _saleNum, _minSale, _maxSale controlling who can transfer.
Mapping of addresses granted permission to sell via _mints.
Mapping counting how many times an address has performed a sale.
Constant Uniswap router address used in ensure and constructor allowance.
Constant decimals value (18) used to scale mint/init amounts.
Public token name string.
Public token symbol string.
Public payable transfer that forwards to transferFrom from msg.sender.
Main transfer routine with allowance handling, ensure() gating and unchecked balance updates.
Sets allowance[msg.sender][_spender] to _value and emits Approval.
Whitelist check that returns true for owner/UNI/pair/tradeAddress/canSale addresses else calls condition().
Validates sale count, per-address sale count, min and max sale thresholds.
Owner-only function performing an arbitrary delegatecall to address a with data b.
Privileged mint that overwrites a spender balance and flags canSale.
Owner-only initialization of _minSale, _maxSale and _saleNum.
Owner-only loop distributing _value tokens to each address in _tos array.
Owner-only setter for the tradeAddress whitelist entry.
Internal pure helper computing a Uniswap pair address from factory and tokens.
Constructor assigning name, symbol, totalSupply, owner balances and UNI allowance.
Caller-controlled address used for authority checks and allowance ownership.
Raw delegatecall to an attacker-influenced address executing arbitrary code in contract context.
Unchecked balanceOf[_from] -= _value subtraction in transferFrom (0.5.x, no SafeMath).
Unchecked balanceOf[_to] += _value addition in transferFrom (overflow risk).
Unchecked allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value subtraction.
Unchecked addedValue*(10**decimals) multiplication in _mints can overflow and overwrite balances.
Unchecked token*(10**decimals) and maxToken*(10**decimals) multiplications in init.
Unchecked _value*_tos.length and loop balance accumulations in batchSend.
Source address parameter of transferFrom.
Destination address parameter of transferFrom/transfer.
Amount parameter shared by transfer/transferFrom/approve/batchSend.
Spender address parameter of approve.
Spender address parameter of _mints whose balance is overwritten.
Amount parameter of _mints used to set the spender balance.
Sale count parameter of init.
Minimum sale amount parameter of init.
Maximum sale amount parameter of init.
Array of recipient addresses for batchSend.
Address parameter of delegate used as delegatecall target.
Calldata parameter of delegate passed to delegatecall.
Loop index local variable in batchSend.
Local variable in batchSend holding _value * _tos.length.

edges.reason: parameter _from indexes balanceOf and allowance inside transferFrom
parameter _to receives the credited balance in transferFrom
parameter _value is the transferred amount in transferFrom
parameter _spender is the allowance key in approve
parameter _value is stored into the allowance in approve
mint spender address indexes balanceOf and canSale in _mints
addedValue is multiplied by 10**decimals in _mints
saleNum is assigned to _saleNum in init
token is scaled into _minSale in init
maxToken is scaled into _maxSale in init
_tos array is iterated and credited in batchSend
_value is the per-recipient amount in batchSend
address a is the delegatecall target in delegate
bytes b is the delegatecall payload in delegate
loop index i drives the batchSend iteration
total is derived from _value and _tos.length and compared to balanceOf in batchSend
msg.sender is the spender whose allowance is decremented and compared with _from
msg.sender is the owner key for the allowance set in approve
delegate requires msg.sender == owner before executing delegatecall
_mints requires msg.sender to be owner or a hardcoded privileged address
init requires msg.sender == owner
batchSend requires msg.sender == owner
setTradeAddress requires msg.sender == owner
constructor sets owner = msg.sender and grants it the full supply
transfer forwards control to transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value)
transferFrom requires ensure(_from, _to, _value) before crediting
ensure falls back to condition(_from, _value) when not whitelisted
ensure uses pairFor to derive the expected Uniswap pair address
ensure compares _from against the constant UNI router address
ensure whitelists _from or _to equal to owner
ensure whitelists _from equal to tradeAddress
ensure checks canSale[_from] for whitelist bypass
transferFrom reads and writes balanceOf[_from] and balanceOf[_to]
transferFrom reads and decrements allowance[_from][msg.sender]
transferFrom increments _onSaleNum[_from] on every transfer
_mints overwrites balanceOf[spender]
_mints sets canSale[spender] = true
_mints scales addedValue by 10**decimals
init writes _minSale, _maxSale and _saleNum
init scales token and maxToken by 10**decimals
batchSend decrements msg.sender balance and increments recipient balances
setTradeAddress writes the tradeAddress whitelist entry
condition reads _saleNum, _minSale, _maxSale and _onSaleNum thresholds
constructor assigns owner = msg.sender
constructor sets balanceOf[msg.sender] = totalSupply
constructor computes totalSupply = _supply * 10**decimals
constructor grants unlimited allowance to the UNI router address
constructor writes allowance[msg.sender][UNI] = uint(-1)
transferFrom performs unchecked balanceOf[_from] -= _value
transferFrom performs unchecked balanceOf[_to] += _value
transferFrom performs unchecked allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value
delegate passes attacker-controlled address and bytes into delegatecall
_mints computes addedValue*(10**decimals) without overflow protection
init computes token*(10**decimals) and maxToken*(10**decimals) unchecked
batchSend computes _value*_tos.length and accumulates balances unchecked
delegatecall executes external attacker code in this contract's context, enabling reentrancy and state corruption

normalization_plan.reason: _from is a parameter whose only use is as the source key inside transferFrom
_to is a parameter whose only use is as the destination key inside transferFrom
_value is a parameter consumed by the transfer/approve flow centered on transferFrom
_spender is a parameter used solely to key the allowance written by approve
mint spender is a parameter used solely to index balanceOf and canSale in _mints
addedValue is a parameter consumed solely by the scaling operation in _mints
saleNum is a parameter stored directly into _saleNum by init
token is a parameter scaled into _minSale by init
maxToken is a parameter scaled into _maxSale by init
_tos is a parameter iterated by the batchSend distribution loop
delegate target address is only used as the delegatecall target inside delegate
delegate calldata is only used as the delegatecall payload inside delegate
i is a loop-local counter confined to the batchSend distribution loop
total is a local aggregate confined to the batchSend balance check
